description: Real-time water data from USGS NWIS streamgages. Filter by site code, state, or parameter (e.g. '00060' = streamflow cfs, '00065' = gage height ft). Useful for flood-stage monitoring, drought tracking, and hydrological research.

parameter_cd.description: USGS parameter code (default '00060' streamflow). Common: 00060=streamflow, 00065=gage height, 00010=water temp, 00400=pH

state_cd.description: Two-letter state code; returns all active sites in the state

name: usgs_water_realtime
